header:
;;; -*- Mode: Lisp -*-
;;; Challenge-rescue experiment (design c_d85_t48_n1, required gain 0.5 bit): the structured reactive controller.
;;; Generated by rsa/ldl_to_cram.py from rsa/registry/lab/challenge_rescue.ldl (LDL v0.3), after rsa/ldl.py checked it:
;;; 8 action designators, 13 causal links, 7 order constraints,
;;; 9/9 threats resolved, 13/13 repair guarantees hold.
;;; Notation: RPL control structures in CRAM Lisp syntax. No device, robot, pose or volume appears: they come
;;; from resolving the instrument roles at run time. Not executed: no Lisp CRAM here. ILLUSTRATIVE values (D016).

(in-package :lab-src)
macros:
;;; LDL clauses as RPL. These macros are the only vocabulary the plans below add to RPL/CRAM.

(defmacro holds (description)
  "A ground entity description as a fluent: true while the belief state answers the query (EQ6).
The belief state is updated by the process modules' monitors and the sensors."
  `(belief-fluent ',description))

(defmacro prevent (fluent failure)
  "LDL prevents: a monitor that never finishes by itself and evaporates with the control structure
it constrains (RPL WITH-POLICY)."
  `(whenever ,fluent (fail ',failure :description ',fluent)))

(defmacro maintain (fluent failure)
  "LDL maintains: the same monitor on the negated condition."
  `(whenever (fl-not ,fluent) (fail ',failure :description '(not ,fluent))))

(defmacro scope ((begin end) &body monitors)
  "LDL scope: the monitors run from the moment BEGIN holds until END holds."
  `(seq (wait-for ,begin) (pursue (wait-for ,end) (par ,@monitors))))

(defmacro ensure (belief &key grade consequential)
  "A requires-item the realization verifies; a shortfall below GRADE is treated by the epistemic
meta model (re-observe, verify, contain-and-escalate, ...)."
  `(treat-shortfall ',belief ',grade ,consequential *epistemic-meta-model*))

(defmacro check-goal (description failure)
  "The goal of an action: checked after the action; if it does not hold, the action fails."
  `(unless (fluent-value (holds ,description)) (fail ',failure :description ',description)))

(defmacro def-action-plan (type (&rest roles) &body body)
  "The plan that PERFORM uses for action designators of TYPE. ROLES are (slot ?variable) pairs
bound from the designator's slots when it is performed."
  `(register-action-plan ',type ',roles (lambda (?self ,@(mapcar #'second roles)) ,@body)))
failures:
;;; Failures: what an action can signal, and the device faults behind each (process models)

(define-condition lab-failure (plan-failure)
  ((designator :initarg :description :reader failure-designator)
   (cause :initarg :cause :initform nil :reader failure-cause))
  (:documentation "A failure designator, e.g. (a failure (type measurement-invalid) (cause out_of_focus))."))

(define-condition contamination-suspected (lab-failure) ())
(define-condition dose-not-delivered (lab-failure)
  ()
  (:documentation "L12 faults: wrong_reagent, tip_missing_or_dropped, clog_or_air_aspiration, well_misregistration"))
(define-condition environment-excursion (lab-failure)
  ()
  (:documentation "L10 faults: temperature_excursion, CO2_excursion, gate_stuck_open"))
(define-condition identity-mismatch (lab-failure) ())
(define-condition measurement-invalid (lab-failure)
  ()
  (:documentation "L17 faults: calibration_expired, plate_misseated, out_of_focus"))
(define-condition prevents-violated (lab-failure) ())
(define-condition validity-effect-unachievable (lab-failure) ())
data:
;;; Quality (for the critic over the audit trail) and the epistemic meta model (for ENSURE)

(defparameter *quality*
  ;; targets and weights ILLUSTRATIVE; to be set with the lab later
  '((a kpi
        (name safety)
        (of (each violation (of (a prevents-item (in ?E)))))
        (aggregate count)
        (target (<= 0))
        (direction minimize))
    (a kpi
        (name reliability)
        (of (each goal (of (an action (in ?E)))))
        (aggregate first-attempt-fraction)
        (target (>= 1))
        (direction maximize))
    (a kpi
        (name auditability)
        (of (each goal (of (an action (in ?E)))))
        (aggregate evidenced-fraction)
        (target (>= 1))
        (direction maximize))
    (a kpi
        (name excursion-time)
        (of (each excursion (of ?p)))
        (aggregate max)
        (unit s)
        (target (<= 300 s))
        (direction minimize))
    (a kpi
        (name cost)
        (of (each resource (used-by ?E)))
        (aggregate weighted-sum)
        (unit cost-units)
        (weights (consumable 1) (instrument-minute 0.2) (escalation 50))
        (target (<= 10))
        (direction minimize))
    (a kpi
        (name dose-deviation)
        (of (each transfer (into (a well (of ?p)))))
        (aggregate max)
        (unit %)
        (target (<= 2 %))
        (direction minimize))
    (a kpi
        (name time-to-result)
        (of ?E)
        (aggregate span)
        (unit h)
        (target (<= 72.5 h))
        (direction minimize))
    (prefers (lexicographic safety
                            reliability
                            auditability
                            excursion-time
                            cost
                            dose-deviation
                            time-to-result))))

(defparameter *epistemic-meta-model*
  ;; registry/lab/epistemic.ldl; the first matching rule applies
  '((rule quarantine-of-the-contradicted
      (when (a belief (of (the plate (identity verified))) (grade (corroboration contradicted)))
        (in (an action (type quarantining))))
      (treat proceed))
    (rule contradiction
      (when (a belief (grade (corroboration contradicted))))
      (treat contain-and-escalate))
    (rule no-belief (when (a belief (grade (source unknown)))) (treat sense-or-abstain))
    (rule stale (when (a belief (grade (freshness stale)))) (treat re-observe))
    (rule prediction (when (a belief (grade (source predicted)))) (treat plan-only))
    (rule reported-by-a-qualified-instrument
      (when (a belief (grade (source reported)) (from (an instrument (binding validated)))))
      (treat proceed))
    (rule reported
      (when (a belief (grade (source reported))) (use consequential))
      (treat verify-before-commit))
    (rule assumed-consequential
      (when (a belief (grade (source (<= assumed)))) (use consequential))
      (treat verify-before-commit))
    (rule weak-routine
      (when (a belief (grade (source (<= reported)))) (use routine))
      (treat proceed-flagged))
    (rule inferred-consequential
      (when (a belief (grade (source (<= inferred)))) (use consequential))
      (treat verify-if-sensable-else-escalate))))
action_plans:
(def-action-plan intervening ((into ?w) (substance ?s) (dose ?q) (at ?t))
  "Goal: (the well ?w (received ?s ?q)). Performed in: x1, x2, x3."
  (let* ((?self (current-action-designator))
         (?p (plate-of ?w))
         (?instrument (an instrument
                          (slot (a plate-slot (accepts ?p)))
                          (process (a process
                                       (type substance-transfer)
                                       (into ?w)
                                       (of ?s)
                                       (amount ?q))))))
    (with-retry-counters ((wrong-reagent-repairs 1) (tip-missing-or-dropped-repairs 1))
      (with-failure-handling
          ((dose-not-delivered (f)
             (case (failure-cause f)
               ;; perform again; guarantees goal-or-safe-state: holds
               (wrong_reagent (do-retry wrong-reagent-repairs
                                (achieve (some substance ?s (identity verified)))
                                (retry)))
               ;; perform again; guarantees goal-or-safe-state: holds
               (tip_missing_or_dropped (do-retry tip-missing-or-dropped-repairs (retry))))))
        (seq
          (ensure (the plate ?p (identity verified))
                  :grade (freshness fresh source observed)
                  :consequential t)
          (ensure (some substance ?s (identity verified))
                  :grade (freshness fresh source observed)
                  :consequential t)
          (ensure (the plate ?p (contamination none))
                  :grade (freshness fresh source inferred)
                  :consequential t)
          ;; supplied by a predecessor in the partial order
          (wait-for (holds (the plate ?p (culture-time ?t))))
          (with-policy (par
                         (prevent (holds (an event (type contamination-introduced) (of ?p)))
                                  contamination-suspected)
                         (scope ((holds (a portion ?u (of ?s) (drawn-for ?self)))
                                 (holds (the portion ?u (delivered true))))
                           (prevent (holds (a transfer (of ?u) (into (a well (of ?p) (not ?w)))))
                                    prevents-violated)))
            (perform (an action (type tending) (instrument ?instrument) (object ?p))))
          (check-goal (the well ?w (received ?s ?q)) dose-not-delivered))))))

(def-action-plan incubating ((plate ?p) (in ?e) (from ?t0) (to ?t1))
  "Goal: (the plate ?p (culture-time ?t1)). Performed in: w1, w2."
  (let* ((?self (current-action-designator))
         (?instrument (an instrument
                          (slot (a plate-slot (accepts ?p)))
                          (process (a process (type incubation) (maintains ?e))))))
    (seq
      ;; supplied by a predecessor in the partial order
      (wait-for (holds (the plate ?p (culture-time ?t0))))
      (achieve (the plate ?p (in ?e)))
      (with-policy (par
                     (prevent (holds (an excursion (of ?p))) environment-excursion)
                     (maintain (holds (the plate ?p (in ?e))) environment-excursion))
        (perform (an action (type tending) (instrument ?instrument) (object ?p))))
      (check-goal (the plate ?p (culture-time ?t1)) environment-excursion))))

(def-action-plan measuring ((of ?w) (readout ?r) (at ?t))
  "Goal: (a measurement (of ?w) (readout ?r) (culture-time ?t)). Performed in: m1, m2, m3."
  (let* ((?self (current-action-designator))
         (?p (plate-of ?w))
         (?instrument (an instrument
                          (slot (a plate-slot (accepts ?p)))
                          (process (a process (type imaging) (of ?w) (readout ?r)))
                          (qualified-for ?r))))
    (with-retry-counters ((calibration-expired-repairs 1)
                          (out-of-focus-repairs 1)
                          (plate-misseated-repairs 1))
      (with-failure-handling
          ((measurement-invalid (f)
             (case (failure-cause f)
               ;; re-resolve and perform again; guarantees goal-or-safe-state: holds
               (calibration_expired (do-retry calibration-expired-repairs
                                      (achieve (an instrument
                                                   (function imaging)
                                                   (calibration current)))
                                      (retry)))
               ;; perform again; guarantees goal-or-safe-state: holds
               (out_of_focus (do-retry out-of-focus-repairs
                               (achieve (the plate ?p (seated true)))
                               (retry)))
               ;; perform again; guarantees goal-or-safe-state: holds
               (plate_misseated (do-retry plate-misseated-repairs
                                  (achieve (the plate ?p (seated true)))
                                  (retry))))))
        (seq
          (ensure (the plate ?p (identity verified))
                  :grade (freshness fresh source observed)
                  :consequential t)
          ;; supplied by a predecessor in the partial order
          (wait-for (holds (the plate ?p (culture-time ?t))))
          (achieve (an instrument (function imaging) (qualified-for ?r) (calibration current)))
          (with-policy (par
                         (prevent (holds (an event (type contamination-introduced) (of ?p)))
                                  contamination-suspected))
            (perform (an action (type tending) (instrument ?instrument) (object ?p))))
          (check-goal (a measurement (of ?w) (readout ?r) (culture-time ?t)) measurement-invalid))))))

(def-action-plan quarantining ((material ?x))
  "Goal: (the plate ?x (contained true))."
  (let* ((?self (current-action-designator))
         (?instrument (an instrument
                          (slot (a plate-slot (accepts ?x)))
                          (process (a process (type containment) (of ?x))))))
    (seq
      (ensure (the plate ?x (identity verified))
              :grade (freshness fresh source observed)
              :consequential t)
      (with-policy (par
                     (prevent (holds (an event
                                         (type release)
                                         (of ?x)
                                         (without (a record
                                                      (type sign-off)
                                                      (by (a person (role reviewer)))))))
                              containment-breach))
        (perform (an action (type tending) (instrument ?instrument) (object ?x))))
      (check-goal (the plate ?x (contained true)) containment-breach))))
experiment_plan:
(def-cram-function challenge-rescue-plan (?p ?r ?c ?k ?ch ?rs ?env)
  "The lab plan: 8 action designators. The order is derived from causal links (rsa/ldl.py);
steps without an order between them may run in any order or concurrently."
  (partial-order
      ((:tag x1
         ;; intervening, culture-time 0 h
         (perform (an action
                      (type intervening)
                      (into ?r)
                      (substance ?ch)
                      (dose 0.85 au)
                      (at (culture-time 0 h)))))
       (:tag x2
         ;; intervening, culture-time 0 h
         (perform (an action
                      (type intervening)
                      (into ?c)
                      (substance ?ch)
                      (dose 0.85 au)
                      (at (culture-time 0 h)))))
       (:tag w1
         ;; incubating, 0 h -> 48 h
         (perform (an action
                      (type incubating)
                      (plate ?p)
                      (in ?env)
                      (from (culture-time 0 h))
                      (to (culture-time 48 h)))))
       (:tag x3
         ;; intervening, culture-time 48 h
         (perform (an action
                      (type intervening)
                      (into ?r)
                      (substance ?rs)
                      (dose 0.70 au)
                      (at (culture-time 48 h)))))
       (:tag w2
         ;; incubating, 48 h -> 72 h
         (perform (an action
                      (type incubating)
                      (plate ?p)
                      (in ?env)
                      (from (culture-time 48 h))
                      (to (culture-time 72 h)))))
       (:tag m1
         ;; measuring, culture-time 72 h
         (perform (an action
                      (type measuring)
                      (of ?r)
                      (readout organoid-radius)
                      (at (culture-time 72 h)))))
       (:tag m2
         ;; measuring, culture-time 72 h
         (perform (an action
                      (type measuring)
                      (of ?c)
                      (readout organoid-radius)
                      (at (culture-time 72 h)))))
       (:tag m3
         ;; measuring, culture-time 72 h
         (perform (an action
                      (type measuring)
                      (of ?k)
                      (readout organoid-radius)
                      (at (culture-time 72 h))))))
    (:order x1 w1)  ; (the well ?r (received ?ch))
    (:order x2 w1)  ; (the well ?c (received ?ch))
    (:order w1 x3)  ; (the plate ?p (culture-time 48 h))
    (:order x3 w2)  ; (the well ?r (received ?rs))
    (:order w2 m1)  ; (the plate ?p (culture-time 72 h))
    (:order w2 m2)  ; (the plate ?p (culture-time 72 h))
    (:order w2 m3)))  ; (the plate ?p (culture-time 72 h))
top_level:
(def-top-level-cram-function challenge-rescue ()
  "Goal: (a result (of ?D) (information-gain (>= 0.5 bit))). Design c_d85_t48_n1, EIG 0.5439 bit."
  ;; the process modules fill the instrument roles;
  ;; rsa/ldl.py resolves them to imaging -> L17; incubation -> L10; substance-transfer -> L12
  (with-process-modules-running (resolve-process-modules)
    (let* ((?D (the design (id c_d85_t48_n1)))
           (?p (the plate (id P17)))
           (?r (the well (of ?p) (role rescued)))
           (?c (the well (of ?p) (role comparator)))
           (?k (the well (of ?p) (role control)))
           (?ch (some substance (type challenge)))
           (?rs (some substance (type rescue)))
           (?env (a controlled-environment (profile culture-standard))))
      ;; experiment-level repairs: they end in escalation, the failure then propagates
      (with-failure-handling
          ((contamination-suspected (f)
             ;; guarantees safe-state, contained: holds
             (perform (an action (type quarantining) (material ?p)))
             (escalate f))
           (dose-not-delivered (f)
             (case (failure-cause f)
               ;; guarantees safe-state: holds
               (clog_or_air_aspiration (escalate f))
               ;; guarantees safe-state, contained: holds
               (well_misregistration (perform (an action (type quarantining) (material ?p)))
                                     (escalate f))
               ;; otherwise, and after the action plan's repairs ran out
               (t (escalate f))))
           (environment-excursion (f)
             ;; guarantees safe-state: holds
             (restore (the plate ?p (in ?env)))
             (escalate f))
           (identity-mismatch (f)
             ;; guarantees safe-state, contained: holds
             (perform (an action (type quarantining) (material (the plate (identity mismatched)))))
             (escalate f))
           (measurement-invalid (f)
             ;; after the action plan's repairs ran out
             (escalate f))
           (prevents-violated (f)
             ;; guarantees safe-state: holds
             (restore (the plate ?p (in ?env)))
             (escalate f))
           (validity-effect-unachievable (f)
             ;; guarantees safe-state: holds
             (escalate f)))
        (unwind-protect
            (seq
              (ensure (the plate ?p (contamination none))
                      :grade (freshness fresh source inferred)
                      :consequential t)
              (ensure-design (the design ?D (arm (role control))))
              (with-policy (par
                             (prevent (holds (an excursion (of ?p) (duration (> 600 s))))
                                      prevents-violated)
                             (prevent (holds (a transfer (of (some substance)) (into ?k)))
                                      prevents-violated)
                             (prevent (holds (an event (type contamination-introduced) (of ?p)))
                                      contamination-suspected)
                             (maintain (holds (the plate ?p (identity verified))) identity-mismatch))
                (challenge-rescue-plan ?p ?r ?c ?k ?ch ?rs ?env)))
          ;; the safe state on any exit: the plate back in its controlled environment
          (achieve (the plate ?p (in ?env))))))))
description:
;; The challenge-rescue experiment (design c_d85_t48_n1, required gain 0.5 bit) as a partially ordered set of lab
;; action designators over entity designators, LDL v0.3. No order is written: rsa/ldl.py derives it from causal links
;; (a goal- or achieves-item of one step entails a requires-item of another), checks threats on functional state
;; (culture-time), resolves the instrument role of every step, checks that every signalled failure is handled, and
;; hands one linear extension to the kernel. No robot, device, pose or volume appears (lint).
;; Doses (arbitrary units) and culture times are the e2m design's; the 600 s limit and every KPI target are
;; ILLUSTRATIVE (D016).

(the action ?E
    (type experimenting)
    (entities
      (the design ?D (id c_d85_t48_n1))
      (the plate ?p (id P17))
      (the well ?r (of ?p) (role rescued))
      (the well ?c (of ?p) (role comparator))
      (the well ?k (of ?p) (role control))
      (some substance ?ch (type challenge))
      (some substance ?rs (type rescue))
      (a controlled-environment ?env (profile culture-standard)))
    (goal (a result (of ?D) (information-gain (>= 0.5 bit))))
    (given (the plate ?p (in ?env)) (the plate ?p (culture-time 0 h)))
    (requires
      (believed (the plate ?p (contamination none)) (grade (source inferred))) :consequential
      (the design ?D (arm (role control))) :column validity)
    (prevents
      (an excursion (of ?p) (duration (> 600 s)))
      (a transfer (of (some substance)) (into ?k))
      (an event (type contamination-introduced) (of ?p)))
    (maintains (known (the plate ?p (identity verified))) :consequential)
    (achieves
      (the plate ?p (in ?env)) :establishable
      (a measurement (of ?r) (readout organoid-radius)) :column validity
      (a measurement (of ?c) (readout organoid-radius)) :column validity
      (a measurement (of ?k) (readout organoid-radius)) :column validity)
    (quality
      ;; targets and weights ILLUSTRATIVE; to be set with the lab later
      (a kpi
          (name safety)
          (of (each violation (of (a prevents-item (in ?E)))))
          (aggregate count)
          (target (<= 0))
          (direction minimize))
      (a kpi
          (name reliability)
          (of (each goal (of (an action (in ?E)))))
          (aggregate first-attempt-fraction)
          (target (>= 1))
          (direction maximize))
      (a kpi
          (name auditability)
          (of (each goal (of (an action (in ?E)))))
          (aggregate evidenced-fraction)
          (target (>= 1))
          (direction maximize))
      (a kpi
          (name excursion-time)
          (of (each excursion (of ?p)))
          (aggregate max)
          (unit s)
          (target (<= 300 s))
          (direction minimize))
      (a kpi
          (name cost)
          (of (each resource (used-by ?E)))
          (aggregate weighted-sum)
          (unit cost-units)
          (weights (consumable 1) (instrument-minute 0.2) (escalation 50))
          (target (<= 10))
          (direction minimize))
      (a kpi
          (name dose-deviation)
          (of (each transfer (into (a well (of ?p)))))
          (aggregate max)
          (unit %)
          (target (<= 2 %))
          (direction minimize))
      (a kpi
          (name time-to-result)
          (of ?E)
          (aggregate span)
          (unit h)
          (target (<= 72.5 h))
          (direction minimize))
      (prefers (lexicographic safety
                              reliability
                              auditability
                              excursion-time
                              cost
                              dose-deviation
                              time-to-result)))
    (handles
      ;; every handler states the guarantee it claims; rsa/ldl.py checks it
      (on (a failure (type identity-mismatch))
        (do (an action (type quarantining) (material (the plate (identity mismatched)))))
        (then escalate)
        (guarantees safe-state contained))
      (on (a failure (type measurement-invalid) (cause calibration_expired))
        (do (re-establish (an instrument (function imaging) (calibration current))))
        (then replan)
        (else escalate)
        (guarantees goal-or-safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type measurement-invalid) (cause out_of_focus))
        (do (re-establish (the plate ?p (seated true))))
        (then (retry (max 1)))
        (else escalate)
        (guarantees goal-or-safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type measurement-invalid) (cause plate_misseated))
        (do (re-establish (the plate ?p (seated true))))
        (then (retry (max 1)))
        (else escalate)
        (guarantees goal-or-safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type validity-effect-unachievable)) (then escalate) (guarantees safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type dose-not-delivered) (cause wrong_reagent))
        (do (re-establish (some substance ?s (identity verified))))
        (then (retry (max 1)))
        (else escalate)
        (guarantees goal-or-safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type dose-not-delivered) (cause tip_missing_or_dropped))
        (then (retry (max 1)))
        (else escalate)
        (guarantees goal-or-safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type dose-not-delivered) (cause clog_or_air_aspiration))
        (then escalate)
        (guarantees safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type dose-not-delivered) (cause well_misregistration))
        (do (an action (type quarantining) (material ?p)))
        (then escalate)
        (guarantees safe-state contained))
      (on (a failure (type contamination-suspected))
        (do (an action (type quarantining) (material ?p)))
        (then escalate)
        (guarantees safe-state contained))
      (on (a failure (type environment-excursion))
        (do (restore (the plate ?p (in ?env))))
        (then escalate)
        (guarantees safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type containment-breach)) (then escalate) (guarantees safe-state))
      (on (a failure (type prevents-violated))
        ;; signalled by the experiment's own prevents monitors
        (do (restore (the plate ?p (in ?env))))
        (then escalate)
        (guarantees safe-state)))
    (steps
      (an action ?x1
          (type intervening)
          (into ?r)
          (substance ?ch)
          (dose 0.85 au)
          (at (culture-time 0 h)))
      (an action ?x2
          (type intervening)
          (into ?c)
          (substance ?ch)
          (dose 0.85 au)
          (at (culture-time 0 h)))
      ;; the design's clock starts at the challenge
      (an action ?w1
          (type incubating)
          (plate ?p)
          (in ?env)
          (from (culture-time 0 h))
          (to (culture-time 48 h))
          (requires (the well ?r (received ?ch)) (the well ?c (received ?ch))))
      (an action ?x3
          (type intervening)
          (into ?r)
          (substance ?rs)
          (dose 0.70 au)
          (at (culture-time 48 h)))
      (an action ?w2
          (type incubating)
          (plate ?p)
          (in ?env)
          (from (culture-time 48 h))
          (to (culture-time 72 h))
          (requires (the well ?r (received ?rs))))  ; the readout is 24 h after the rescue
      (an action ?m1 (type measuring) (of ?r) (readout organoid-radius) (at (culture-time 72 h)))
      (an action ?m2 (type measuring) (of ?c) (readout organoid-radius) (at (culture-time 72 h)))
      (an action ?m3 (type measuring) (of ?k) (readout organoid-radius) (at (culture-time 72 h)))))
